# Anatomy geometry core

Source: https://github.com/wheresryan22/anatomy

Pinned commit: bc943e40c59998be5da61f9d39c6a983b1116099

`iso-kit.mjs` is an unmodified copy of `kit/iso-kit.mjs`. MIT copyright and permission notice are retained in LICENSE. Only numeric geometry builders are used by the platform adapter; upstream build scripts and generated provider code are never executed. Scene geometry is a simplified educational representation, not a clearance or mechanical engineering audit.
